options.name: access_token
options.description: An OAuth2 access token if credential type is accesstoken.

options.name: address
options.description: The static external IP address represented by this resource.

options.name: address_type
options.description: The type of the address to reserve. * EXTERNAL indicates public/external single IP address. * INTERNAL indicates internal IP ranges belonging to some network. Some valid choices include: "EXTERNAL", "INTERNAL"

options.name: description
options.description: An optional description of this resource.

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: ip_version
options.description: The IP Version that will be used by this address. The default value is `IPV4`. Some valid choices include: "IPV4", "IPV6"

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the resource. Provided by the client when the resource is created. The name must be 1-63 characters long, and comply with RFC1035. Specifically, the name must be 1-63 characters long and match the regular expression `[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?` which means the first character must be a lowercase letter, and all following characters must be a dash, lowercase letter, or digit, except the last character, which cannot be a dash.

options.name: network
options.description: The URL of the network in which to reserve the IP range. The IP range must be in RFC1918 space. The network cannot be deleted if there are any reserved IP ranges referring to it. This should only be set when using an Internal address. This field represents a link to a Network resource in GCP. It can be specified in two ways. First, you can place a dictionary with key 'selfLink' and value of your resource's selfLink Alternatively, you can add `register: name-of-resource` to a gcp_compute_network

options.name: prefix_length
options.description: The prefix length of the IP range. If not present, it means the address field is a single IP address. This field is not applicable to addresses with addressType=EXTERNAL, or addressType=INTERNAL when purpose=PRIVATE_SERVICE_CONNECT .

options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use.

options.name: purpose
options.description: The purpose of the resource. Possible values include: * VPC_PEERING - for peer networks * PRIVATE_SERVICE_CONNECT - for ([Beta](U(https://terraform.io/docs/providers/google/guides/provider_versions.html)) only) Private Service Connect networks .

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the given object should exist in GCP
